description: This file contains implementation of wrapper functions for nl80211 interface, handling MLD (Multi-Link Device) and SSID related operations, including interface info retrieval, link ID management, and station matching.

methods.name: wld_ssid_nl80211_getMldIfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves MLD interface info associated with a given SSID, including link ID and interface details, using either direct interface info or link MAC address.

methods.name: wld_ssid_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Obtains interface information for a given SSID, considering MLD links and fallback to primary link interface info.

methods.name: wld_ssid_nl80211_getPrimaryLinkIfIndex
methods.description: Returns the interface index of the primary link for a given SSID, considering active MLD links.

methods.name: wld_ssid_nl80211_getMldLinkId
methods.description: Returns the MLD link ID associated with a given SSID.

methods.name: wld_ssid_nl80211_matchIfSta
methods.description: Checks if a station info matches the SSID's MLD link ID or is a legacy station.

methods.name: wld_ssid_nl80211_getPrefStaLinkId
methods.description: Determines the preferred station link ID based on existing links, main link, or frequency band matching.
